To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduced RRC architecture over multi-scale features for single stage object detection and localization.
we introduced Recurrent Rolling Convoltion (RRC) which is an end-to-end trainable architecture to build object classifiers and bounding boxes regressors.

we proposed a single stage end-to- end trainable object detection network that uses a novel Recurrent Rolling Convnet (RRC) to construct object classifiers, bounding box regressors and feature maps that are deep in context, and we showed that with RCC, a single reduced model based on VGG-16 significantly outperforms all previous single stage methods, including those based on the popular Faster R-CNN, in terms of mAP for high IOU thresholds, on the KITTI benchmark
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of detecting objects in an image.
the problem of detecting objects in a video sequence.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is the first single stage method that can achieve comparable performance to the two-stage methods in terms of accuracy.
we introduced Recurrent Rolling Convotion (RRC) which is a novel single stage object detection architecture.
the RRC architecture can significantly boost the performance of single stage object detection models and can be easily incorporated with existing single stage methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we achieved state-of-the-art results on KITTI benchmark with a single stage detector.
we achieved the state of the art results in single stage object detection with a single model.
our method can be used to build accurate object detection models that can run in real time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the single stage object detection methods are not inferior to the two stage methods when using a deep enough network and the appropriate architecture.
a single stage detector can be competitive in accuracy when the model is deep in context.
single stage object detection is possible with high performance and accuracy if the network is trained end-to-end with a deep architecture that can capture context over multiple scales.
